# MIDI ROOM

> Free online MIDI player and explorer. Upload or play MIDI files, visualize notes, and explore public-domain songs.

## Main pages
- [Home](https://midiplayeronline.com/): Online MIDI player
- [Songs](https://midiplayeronline.com/songs/): Public-domain song library with built-in demo players
- [Christmas Songs MIDI](https://midiplayeronline.com/songs/christmas/): 10 public-domain holiday carols, play free online
- [Public Domain MIDI](https://midiplayeronline.com/songs/public-domain/): Free no-copyright classical & folk melodies
